label: Business Systems
what_it_is: Custom operational software: portals, workflows, roles, and internal tools.
best_for: Schools/businesses that need logins, applications, or multi-role processes
Operations that a brochure website cannot carry
good_when: Online applications, gated content, or multi-step ops
They describe a system, not a marketing site
not_good_when: They only need public credibility and enquiries — recommend a website package instead
expert_recommendation: Say plainly when the need is a system. Do not sell a Basic website as if it were an LMS.
upsell_only_when: N/A — this is the correct lane when workflows require it.
important_tradeoff: More discovery and build time vs a simple public site. Be honest about scope.
